title: hotfix: fix SLO enforcer ordering race during regional failover
author: Ava Thompson
body:
Motivation: During a multi-region outage triggered in staging we observed an intermittent ordering race in the SLO Enforcer that could cause regional failover to attempt overlapping rollbacks and double-shed traffic for a small window. This led to short periods of over-shedding and client-facing 5xx spikes. This hotfix stabilizes the ordering of enforcer actions during regional failover and adds defensive checks to avoid duplicate load-shedding decisions.

Summary of changes: 1) Serialize the failover action queue using a lightweight compare-and-swap on the enforcer lease to prevent concurrent ordering; 2) Add idempotency keys to load-shedding transitions so duplicate triggers are no-ops; 3) Tighten metrics and tracing around SLO transitions to make races visible in telemetry; 4) Add targeted unit and integration tests that reproduce the previously observed race.

Checklist: - [x] Reproduce race locally (integration harness) - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Run full CI + canary on staging - [x] Add release notes and rollback plan - [x] Sanity-stable on staging for 24h before merge

Testing notes: The integration test harness includes a deterministic scheduler that repros the ordering condition; tests added to enforcer_test.go and regional_failover_integration test ensure idempotent transitions. Verified metrics surface the enforcer_state transitions in staging and Grafana alerts are not triggered after patch.

Rollout and rollback: This is a low-risk hotfix. We merged to main and deployed as a canary to us-west-2 (10% traffic) for 2 hours, then ramped to 50% and finally full. Rollback steps are to revert the release in the deployment manifest and re-run the previous canary image.

Related work: linked_linear ENG-2987, ENG-4521. Incident SUP-321 documented the original observation.

Notes for reviewers: Focus on correctness of compare-and-swap usage in enforcer lease code and ensure idempotency key derivation is deterministic across nodes.
commits: a1f3d2c: enforcer: serialize failover action queue with lease CAS and tests
b2e4f11: enforcer: add idempotency keys to load-shedding transitions
c3d5a22: telemetry: add enforcer_state and transition tracing
d4e6b33: tests: add deterministic integration harness for ordering race
files_changed: services/enforcer/enforcer.go - add lease CAS and serialize queue
services/enforcer/enforcer_test.go - unit tests for CAS and idempotency
release_notes: Hotfix: Prevent SLO Enforcer ordering race during regional failover. Adds idempotent transitions and serialized failover actions to avoid duplicate load-shedding. No breaking changes; safe to roll back to previous image if regressions are observed.
review_comments: Diego Martinez (2026-02-16): The CAS looks correct but please add a metric for CAS retry count so we can monitor contention - also ensure we don't hold the lease longer than necessary.
Ava Thompson (2026-02-16): Added cas_retry_count and bounded lease hold time (300ms). Updated tests to assert retry metrics.
Priya Patel (2026-02-17): Left a small nit on idempotency key derivation - prefer namespace+monotonic counter to avoid crypto overhead. Otherwise LGTM.
Ava Thompson (2026-02-17): Switched idempotency key to namespace + transition counter stored in the lease record; integration tests updated.
Liam O'Connor (2026-02-18): Verified staging canary for 24h with no regression. Approving for merge.
merge_notes: Canary verified in us-west-2; full rollout performed after 2 hour ramp with no alerts. Squash-merged to main and deployed via automated CD pipeline.
safety_and_mitigation: Added additional telemetry to detect contention; alerts created (SRE playbook) if cas_retry_count > 50/min or if enforcer_state thrash observed. Rollback documented in runbook.
backport_plan: No backport required; main-only hotfix. If customers on older release request, we will cherry-pick the change onto release branches after triage.
notes_for_oncall: If 5xx spikes return after deploy, immediately rollback canary image and check cas_retry_count and enforcer_state transition counts in the last 15m. Contact author Ava Thompson and SRE on-call.
security_considerations: No new privileged operations. Idempotency keys are deterministic but contain only service namespace and counter - no sensitive data.
observability_changes: New metrics: enforcer_state_transitions_total, cas_retry_count, transition_idempotent_skipped_total. Traces include enforcer.action_id and lease_id for easier correlation.
test_plan: Unit tests (enforcer_test.go) for CAS and idempotency, deterministic integration reproduction (regional_failover_integration_test) runs in CI. Manual canary in staging for 24h.
psf_notes: This fixes an incident observed in SUP-321 and should reduce transient over-shedding during multi-region failovers. Monitored for 72h post-merge.
